newsitem.title: EGYPT: Gas field discovered off Egyptian north coast.
newsitem.headline: Gas field discovered off Egyptian north coast.

text.p: Egypt's Gulf of Suez Petroleum Co (GUPCO) has found a gas field in Ras el-Barr concession off the northern coast of Egypt, the oil ministry said on Monday.
The concession belongs to Amoco Corp (50 percent) and International Egyptian Oil Company (IEOC) (50 percent). Amoco is the operator and GUPCO subcontractor. IECO is a unit of Italy's AGIP SpA.
An exploratory well, Osiris East 1, found a gas-bearing layer six metres thick at a depth of 4,050 metres, the ministry added.

The well produces 35 million cubic feet (991,000 cubic metres) per day of natural gas and 2,275 barrels per day of condensates, an oil executive told Reuters. "It produces at very good rates," said the executive, who declined to be named.
The well is 60 km (37 miles) northeast of the coastal city of Damietta, the ministry said.
Amoco has found gas in the adjacent Al-Qara concession, 10 km (six miles) to the west.
Recent exploration in the Mediterranean off the Nile Delta has produced a spate of gas discoveries.
Oil companies are describing it as a gas zone of international significance.
